glossary.definition: (A) "Criminal offense" means an alleged act or omission committed by a person that is punishable by incarceration and is not eligible to be disposed of by the traffic violations bureau.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:
As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (C) "Defendant" means a person who is alleged to be the perpetrator of a criminal offense in a complaint, indictment, or information that charges the commission of a criminal offense and that provides the basis for the criminal prosecution and subsequent proceedings to which this chapter makes reference.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (D) "Member of the victim's family" means a spouse, child, stepchild, sibling, parent, stepparent, grandparent, or other relative of a victim but does not include a person who is charged with, convicted of, or adjudicated to be a delinquent child for the criminal offense or delinquent act against the victim or another criminal offense or delinquent act arising from the same conduct, criminal episode, or plan.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition:
(E) "Prosecutor" means one of the following:

(1) With respect to a criminal case, it has the same meaning as in section 2935.01 of the Revised Code and also includes the attorney general and, when appropriate, the employees of any person listed in section 2935.01 of the Revised Code or of the attorney general.

(2) With respect to a delinquency proceeding, it includes any person listed in division (C) of section 2935.01 of the Revised Code or an employee of a person listed in that division who prosecutes a delinquency proceeding.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (F) "Public agency" means an office, agency, department, bureau, or other governmental entity of the state or of a political subdivision of the state.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (G) "Public official" has the same meaning as in section 2921.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (H) "Victim" has the same meaning as in Section 10a of Article I of the Ohio Constitution.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (I) "Victim's representative" means a member of the victim's family or another person who pursuant to the authority of section 2930.02 of the Revised Code exercises the rights of a victim under this chapter.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (J) "Court" means a court of common pleas, juvenile court, municipal court, or county court.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (K) "Delinquency proceeding" means all proceedings in a juvenile court that are related to a case in which a complaint has been filed alleging that a child is a delinquent child.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (L) "Case" means a delinquency proceeding and all related activity or a criminal prosecution and all related activity.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (M) The "defense" means the defense against criminal charges in a criminal prosecution or the defense against a delinquent child complaint in a delinquency proceeding.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (N) The "prosecution" means the prosecution of criminal charges in a criminal prosecution or the prosecution of a delinquent child complaint in a delinquency proceeding.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:
As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (P)(1) "Alleged juvenile offender" means a child who is alleged to have committed a delinquent act in a police report or in a complaint in juvenile court that charges the commission of a delinquent act and that provides the basis for the delinquency proceeding and all subsequent proceedings to which this chapter makes reference.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (2) As used in divisions (O) and (P)(1) of this section, "child" has the same meaning as in section 2151.011 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (Q) "Motor vehicle accident" means any accident involving a motor vehicle.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (R) "Motor vehicle" has the same meaning as in section 4509.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (S) "Aircraft" has the same meaning as in section 4561.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition:
(T) "Aquatic device" means any vessel, or any water skis, aquaplane, or similar device.

(U) "Vehicle," "streetcar," and "trackless trolley" have the same meanings as in section 4511.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (V) "Vehicle, streetcar, trackless trolley, aquatic device, or aircraft accident" means any accident involving a vehicle, streetcar, trackless trolley, aquatic device, or aircraft.
glossary.normalized: vehicle, streetcar, trackless trolley, aquatic device, or aircraft accident
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:
glossary.term: Vehicle, streetcar, trackless trolley, aquatic device, or aircraft accident

glossary.definition: (W) "Vessel" has the same meaning as in section 1546.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (X) "Victim advocate" means a person employed or authorized by a public or private entity who provides support and assistance for a victim of a criminal offense or delinquent act in relation to criminal, civil, administrative, and delinquency cases or proceedings and recovery efforts related to the criminal offense or delinquent act.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (Y) "Victim's attorney" means an attorney retained by the victim for the purpose of asserting the victim's constitutional and statutory rights.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition: (Z) "Prosecutor's designee" means any person or entity designated by the prosecuting attorney but does not include a court or court employee.
glossary.scope: As used in this chapter, unless otherwise defined in any section in this chapter:

glossary.definition:
(AA) "Suspect" means a person who is alleged to be the perpetrator of a criminal offense.
